description: Index of every built-in Ferrum Edge plugin at v0.9.19: name, registration failure policy, documented priority, phases and protocol surface, and a pointer to the plugin's config schema in Edge's published openapi.yaml. Build-time custom plugins are not listed.

provenance.note: v0.9.19 retains the 82 registered types, removed names and PluginConfigBase pointers. Configuration components include the production-launch plugin hardening, multi-location key_auth, SPIFFE forwarding, external-identity access rules, telemetry redaction, resource bounds and plugin association preconditions documented in the owner upgrade guide. Registration failure policy and parity metadata are transcribed from the same tag; referenced config schemas are not copied here.

config_schema_document.note: Each config_schema.pointer is a JSON Pointer into this exact file. The schemas are OpenAPI 3.1 (JSON Schema 2020-12 dialect) and may $ref other components in the same document. They apply to `config` only when the plugin config is enabled. They are referenced, not copied, in this release; see docs/adoption.md (follow-ups).

protocol_values.http: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, including HTTPS
protocol_values.tcp: Raw TCP stream proxy, including TLS termination and origination
protocol_values.udp: Raw UDP datagram proxy, including DTLS termination and origination

plugins.name: request_transformer
plugins.protocol_rationale: Modifies HTTP headers/query/body; WebSocket handshake headers/query only

plugins.name: ai_token_metrics
plugins.protocol_rationale: HTTP JSON/SSE accounting only; native gRPC protobuf has no supported provider schema contract

plugins.name: ws_frame_logging
plugins.protocol_rationale: `on_ws_policy_close` records final policy Close decisions; delivery observations are emitted after successful destination sends

removed_plugins.name: oauth2_auth
removed_plugins.note: Removed built-in. Edge refuses a config that names it, so an upgrade cannot silently drop the protection it provided.
